findings.finding: Use generating polynomials: α(z)=εz^sD(z), D monic divisor of 1+z^d. D must be product of cyclotomics Φ_n with same ν₂(n). List n≤30, deg≤8: f=1:{2,6,10,14,18,30}, f=2:{4,12,20}, f=3:{8,24}, f=4:{16}. Count distinct D (22). Each gives 2·(9−deg(D)) α. Sum=160. Pitfall: ensure all n share same ν₂; avoid double‑counting empty set.
